error: Medication filed as an allergy
supporting_example: A10 enc 00071 amlodipine in allergies and in medications
frequency_evidence: 3 of 38 allergy entries duplicate a listed medication (00071 00386 00445)
likely_cause: Allergy question follows the medication turns; model fills the allergies section with the nearest drug name; prompt pushes to fill sections
proposed_corrective_action: Deterministic check: drop or flag an allergy whose substance is also a listed medication unless a transcript segment says allergic/reaction; consider prompt wording change

error: Two drugs fused into one entry (attributes and name blended)
supporting_example: A13 enc 00445 hydrocortisone cream received fluticasone dose route duration and indication; fluticasone absent
frequency_evidence: 1 confirmed record; related misattribution in 3 of 43 doses
likely_cause: Single pass over a long transcript with many fields; attribute carry-over between adjacent drugs
proposed_corrective_action: Extract one drug at a time from its own question-and-answer window; check every dose and unit against the same or next patient turn

error: Prescribed drugs missing from output
supporting_example: enc 00064 fluconazole 00359 clopidogrel 00143 tamsulosin 00021 ferrous sulfate
frequency_evidence: 14 of 20 doctor prescription phrases name a drug absent from medications and clinical_actions (heuristic); 8 of 9 spot-checked drugs absent from the whole output
likely_cause: Long output with many sections; treatment sentences late in the transcript are under-attended; model prioritises patient-stated medicines
proposed_corrective_action: Deterministic trigger-phrase detector for prescription sentences that feeds a second focused pass or flags the record

error: Dose attached to the wrong drug
supporting_example: A28 enc 00096 Thyronorm 500 mg (true 50 micrograms; 500 mg is Glycomet)
frequency_evidence: 3 of 43 doses appear only elsewhere in the transcript; same-segment mismatches are invisible to the check
likely_cause: Transcript puts the dose before the drug name in one segment ("It's 500 milligrams. It's Thyronorm"); proximity reading by a 0.6B model
proposed_corrective_action: Per-drug windowed extraction; flag a dose that was also the previous drug's dose; unit and magnitude plausibility list for common drugs; mark unverified doses

error: Invented or placeholder allergy entries
affected_component: Stage 1 model plus P02 prompt conflict
supporting_example: A07 enc 00034 allergies none with no allergy question; A36 enc 00345 none for a disputed answer
frequency_evidence: 16 of 38 allergy entries are "none" (invalid enum); 5 of those in records with no allergy question
likely_cause: Prompt says do not leave sections empty and also says denied allergies belong in negative_findings; model resolves by writing none
proposed_corrective_action: Remove "none" allergy entries in Python; allow an allergy fact only when an allergy question or statement exists; handle "no known allergies" as a labelled negative with its own evidence rule

error: Positive finding or condition emitted as an absent finding
supporting_example: A09 enc 00081 morning shakiness; A17 enc 00096 thin bones; A21 enc 00223 COPD flare-up; A26 enc 00395 tiredness
frequency_evidence: 4 of 4 audited negatives with errors; 21 of 53 negative findings share a word with a positive entry in the same record (upper bound)
likely_cause: Single negative-findings list is generated from a transcript full of "no ..." phrases and positive mentions; model copies the nearest symptom
proposed_corrective_action: Contradiction check against positive sections; derive negatives only from segments with a negation cue in the patient answer; send flagged items to abstain

error: Negative findings under-extracted (one per record)
supporting_example: All records; position 0 holds 50 of 53 items
frequency_evidence: 47 of 50 records have a single negative finding although many denials exist
likely_cause: Model stops after one item or confuses the list with the allergy placeholder
proposed_corrective_action: Segment-level pass over doctor-question and patient-denial pairs

error: Placeholder or schema words emitted as facts
supporting_example: A04 enc 00119 finding absent; A34 enc 00173 assessment provisional
frequency_evidence: 5 negative findings named absent; 6 assessments equal provisional or differential
likely_cause: Schema tokens copied into free-text fields
proposed_corrective_action: Drop entries whose text equals an allowed-value word; grammar-constrained decoding

error: Wrong or empty reported_by
supporting_example: A08 A12 A22 A25 A40 (doctor or patient mismatches); A01 A20 doubtful
frequency_evidence: Among 172 patient-answered cited facts: reported_by patient 44% doctor 40% empty 16%; mixed case values 75
likely_cause: Model defaults to doctor; role names copied in upper case from the transcript
proposed_corrective_action: Derive reported_by or observed_by deterministically from the role of the cited segment; remove the field from the model task

error: Invented timestamps and dates
supporting_example: A45 enc 00223 scheduled_datetime 2023-04-10T10:00:00Z in five fields; A29 enc 00034 388.63s
frequency_evidence: 10 procedures with a scheduled_datetime; only 3 of those transcripts mention any date or weekday
likely_cause: Timestamp tokens in the input leak into datetime fields; ISO date attractor repeated by autoregression
proposed_corrective_action: Set datetime fields to null unless the transcript contains a date expression; remove timestamps from the Stage-1 input

error: Doctor procedural talk emitted as finding or action
supporting_example: A14 enc 00436 pressure in the right knee; A15 enc 00395 I'll have a look; A35 enc 00203 planned consultation now
frequency_evidence: 3 audited items; enc 00203 also lists examine the patient as a completed action
likely_cause: Model extracts imperative or procedural sentences as clinical content
proposed_corrective_action: Filter statements that are exam manoeuvres (let me / I'll / tell me if); allow follow_up only with a return-visit lexicon or a doctor statement about a later visit

error: Wrong container shape lost by the pipeline
affected_component: Model output plus Python (no repair step)
supporting_example: clinical_assessment as an object in enc 00064 00071 00081
frequency_evidence: 20 of 50 clinical_assessment and 14 of 50 follow_up are objects not lists; the frozen evaluator and P05 skip them
likely_cause: Model drops the list brackets for single items; no normalization layer exists
proposed_corrective_action: Deterministic wrap of an object into a one-item list before scoring or citation; report with and without the repair

error: Invalid enum or wrong value form
supporting_example: allergy_type none; action_type consultation or prescription; responsible_person DOCTOR
frequency_evidence: 16 plus 15 plus 8 plus 4 violations
likely_cause: Allowed values given only in prose; capitalised roles copied
proposed_corrective_action: Enum mapper with a logged substitution table; grammar-constrained decoding if available

error: Normalization drift and lexical mismatch
affected_component: Stage 1 model plus P02 terminology rule
supporting_example: A21 enc 00223 COPD flare-up to coping disorder; A18 A38 hypertension vs high blood pressure
frequency_evidence: 4 drifted fields in one record; vocabulary misses in 2 abstentions
likely_cause: Rule to replace everyday wording by medical terms is applied to plain fields; small model misreads abbreviations
proposed_corrective_action: Keep plain fields verbatim; normalise with a curated dictionary in Python; add a term map to retrieval

error: Disputed reports flattened; uncertainties never recorded
supporting_example: A31 enc 00386 fever; A36 enc 00345 allergies
frequency_evidence: clinical_uncertainties empty in 50 of 50 records
likely_cause: 0.6B model ignores the optional section; no trigger
proposed_corrective_action: Deterministic detector for a caregiver contradicting the patient (caregiver or family segment following a patient answer) that creates a flag

error: Loss of kinship specificity
supporting_example: A30 enc 00147 and A32 enc 00086 relation family instead of brother and sister
frequency_evidence: 2 of 3 family-history items audited
likely_cause: Model generalises the relation
proposed_corrective_action: Extract kinship terms from the cited segment by lexicon

error: Defaulted symptom attributes (category certainty body site)
supporting_example: A42 A02 A24 A33 category cardiovascular
frequency_evidence: 27 of 57 symptoms labelled cardiovascular; 30 of 57 uncertain
likely_cause: Default-token attractor; fields unrelated to the transcript
proposed_corrective_action: Drop or recompute category with a symptom dictionary; set certainty to null unless a hedge word is present

error: Retrieval cites a lexical match for a wrong or unstated fact
supporting_example: A07 A15 A35 A43 unsupported; A17 A21 contradicted
frequency_evidence: 8 of 8 unsupported or contradicted citations
likely_cause: Matching words alone select a segment; the polarity rule cannot know the fact is wrong
proposed_corrective_action: Gate by context: allergy needs allergy Q and A; follow_up needs return-visit phrase; negative needs a negation scope covering the finding; split doctor turns into sentences

error: Answer attached to a doctor turn holding several statements
frequency_evidence: 2 audited contradicted citations
likely_cause: The next segment is attached to the whole turn even if the matched words sit in an earlier statement
proposed_corrective_action: Sentence-level split and pair only when the matched words are in the question sentence

error: Abstention on ties and vocabulary

frequency_evidence: 7 of 15 audited abstentions judged inappropriate
likely_cause: Equal matches abstain; no lay-medical map; items filed in the wrong section have no anchor fields
